rows.q: How does Ashtakoota matching work and what is a good score?
rows.answer: Ashtakoota matching is a traditional Vedic system that compares two birth charts by examining the distance and relationship between the Moon signs and nakshatras of both individuals. Traditions differ on certain scoring variants and rule interpretations, but the method evaluates compatibility across eight different categories totaling 36 possible points. Many practitioners view a score above 18 as a baseline of general compatibility, while higher totals point to greater harmony in shared life themes. Beyond the numerical sum, individual factors such as Dina and Gana koota are often reviewed to understand daily communication and temperament patterns. For reflection, consider how mutual respect, shared values, and open dialogue remain central to any partnership regardless of numerical totals.

rows.q: Explain Vimshottari dasha in detail
rows.answer: Vimshottari is a nakshatra-based planetary period system that divides a 120-year human life into nine consecutive major periods known as Mahadashas, each ruled by one of the nine grahas. This framework acts as a timing mechanism, highlighting which planetary themes are currently active in your life rather than operating as a standalone prediction machine. At birth, the exact placement of your sidereal Moon in the Ashlesha nakshatra determines your starting period and the sequence of subsequent lords. For your sidereal Taurus Ascendant chart, you are currently moving through your Venus Mahadasha accompanied by the Mercury Antardasha. When evaluating these periods, traditions consider multiple layers including the houses a planet rules, its sign placement, and the condition of the nakshatra lord. For instance, your sidereal Sun and Mercury reside in Meena in the eleventh house, while your sidereal Moon occupies Karka in the third house. Meanwhile, your sidereal Saturn sits in Makara in the ninth house, bringing its own structural influence to your timeline. As you reflect on these cycles, consider keeping a personal journal to track how the shifting sub-periods resonate with your daily experiences and creative aspirations.
